verdict.rationale: The quickstart documents connecting GitHub or GitLab in about 5 minutes and getting automated feedback on your first pull request, and Greptile reviews every PR automatically. Review comments carry file paths and line numbers, take emoji reactions and replies, and are linked from a summary findings list; a community user at an employer confirms it comments on PRs before human review. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that comments are posted as native inline diff comments via an installed GitHub/GitLab App, and evidence of how long a review takes to post after a PR opens (the 5-minute figure covers setup, not review turnaround).
